text:
Ari: Quick flag from today's hallway test: users missed that duplicate priorities existed. Idea: add an inline "Ordering beacon" (subtle left strip + pill on hover) that surfaces a Resolve walkthrough when clicked. Josie: Accessibility: beacon must be focusable (tabindex=0) and exposed to screen readers. When it appears programmatically, announce via aria-live. Example: ```html
Ordering notice: 2 rules share priority in Route: Checkout.
``` Also ensure the beacon has aria-haspopup if it opens a dialog. Mika: Walkthrough flow should be non-blocking. Open a slim overlay (not full modal) with step-by-step suggestions: 1) Move up/down 2) Auto-suggest based on specificity 3) Merge. Primary actions are Move Up/Down; Merge under More. Keep keyboard hints visible. Ravi: From sim side, resolving via the walkthrough should trigger a lightweight preview first. Proposed API: POST /routes/:id/ordering-preview with body {changes:[...]}. If user commits, PATCH /routes/:id/resolve-order {action:..., sim_apply:true} returns a route_delta we can patch into the sandbox without a full run. Josie: Screen-reader flow: when overlay opens, focus moves to the first step and announce "Opened ordering walkthrough for Route Checkout, 2 items. Use arrow keys to navigate." When an action is applied announce the result via aria-live: "Moved 'Payment - USD' before 'Payment - EUR'. Preview updated." Ari: Microcopy: beacon label "Ordering notice" (tooltip on hover: "Rules share priority — resolve"), overlay title "Ordering walkthrough", primary CTAs "Move up" / "Move down", secondary "Auto-suggest" and "Merge". Auto-suggest copy: "Promote most-specific rule (confidence: high)". Merge requires typed confirmation. ux-bot: Uploaded mock: https://redwood.design/mockups/1749991111-ordering-beacon-walkthrough.png :sparkles: Mika: Dev checklist: 1) render beacon (focusable + aria-describedby) 2) aria-live announcer for programmatic appearances 3) slim overlay with keyboard nav + steps 4) preview endpoint POST /routes/:id/ordering-preview 5) commit endpoint PATCH /routes/:id/resolve-order returning route_delta for incremental sim 6) unit tests for SR announcements and focus return. Ari: Great. Josie will drop the ARIA snippets and SR script; Ravi will draft the preview/commit API shape; Mika and I will prototype the beacon + overlay and demo at next UX sync. Thanks! :raised_hands:
